results.title: The Lego Batman Movie
results.original_title: The Lego Batman Movie
results.overview: A cooler-than-ever Batman must face the usual villains as the Joker plots a takeover of Gotham City. But when Bruce Wayne accidentally adopts a teenage orphan who wishes to become his sidekick, he’s forced to give up his lone-vigilante ways and learn to work with others.

results.title: Suicide Squad: Hell to Pay
results.original_title: Suicide Squad: Hell to Pay
results.overview: Amanda Waller's top-secret "Task Force X" — consisting of Deadshot, Bronze Tiger, Killer Frost, Captain Boomerang, Harley Quinn, and Copperhead — is on a mission to retrieve a mystical object so powerful that they're willing to risk their lives to steal it. However, the Suicide Squad isn't the only group of villains seeking to possess the object. It's a race for the golden prize, and second place isn't an option if they want to stay alive.

results.title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
results.original_title: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies
results.overview: All the major DC superheroes are starring in their own films, all but the Teen Titans, so Robin is determined to remedy this situation by getting over his role as a sidekick and becoming a movie star. Thus, with a few madcap ideas and an inspirational song in their hearts, the Teen Titans head to Hollywood to fulfill their dreams.

results.title: Constantine: City of Demons - The Movie
results.original_title: Constantine: City of Demons - The Movie
results.overview: A decade after a tragic mistake, family man Chas Chandler and occult detective John Constantine set out to cure his daughter Trish from a mysterious supernatural coma.

results.title: Justice League Dark
results.original_title: Justice League Dark
results.overview: When innocent civilians begin committing unthinkable crimes across Metropolis, Gotham City and beyond, Batman must call upon mystical counterparts to eradicate this demonic threat to the planet; enter Justice League Dark. This team of Dark Arts specialists must unravel the mystery of Earth's supernatural plague and contend with the rising, powerful villainous forces behind the siege—before it's too late for all of mankind.

results.title: Batman Ninja
results.original_title: ニンジャバットマン
results.overview: Batman, along with many of his allies and adversaries, finds himself transported to feudal Japan by Gorilla Grodd's time displacement machine.

results.title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Cosmic Clash
results.original_title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Cosmic Clash
results.overview: Earth, a shiny jewel floating in the blackness of space... and for the robot known as Brainiac, the last piece to capture for his collection of planets. Not if the Justice League has anything to say about it!

results.title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: The Flash
results.original_title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: The Flash
results.overview: Reverse-Flash manipulates the Speed Force to put the Flash into a time loop that forces him to relive the same day over and over again—with progressively disastrous results, including losing his powers and being fired by the Justice League. The Flash must find a way to restore time to its original path and finally apprehend his worst enemy before all is lost for the Flash…and the world!

results.title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
results.original_title: Teen Titans Go! vs. Teen Titans
results.overview: The comedic modern-day quintet takes on their 2003 counterparts when villains from each of their worlds join forces to pit the two Titan teams against each other. They'll need to set aside their differences and work together to combat Trigon, Hexagon, Santa Claus (that's right, Santa!) and time itself in order to save the multiverse.

results.title: The Death of Superman
results.original_title: The Death of Superman
results.overview: When a hulking monster arrives on Earth and begins a mindless rampage, the Justice League is quickly called in to stop it. But it soon becomes apparent that only Superman can stand against the monstrosity.

results.title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League vs. Bizarro League
results.original_title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League vs. Bizarro League
results.overview: Superman’s clone, Bizarro, has become an embarrassing problem. Chaos and destruction follow Bizarro everywhere as he always hears the opposite of what is said, says the opposite of what he means and does the opposite of what is right. And when the citizens of Metropolis keep confusing Bizarro with Superman, the Man of Steel decides it’s time to find a new home for him…on another planet! It’s up to the Justice League to come to terms with their backward counterparts and team up with them to stop Darkseid and save the galaxy!

results.title: LEGO DC Super Hero Girls: Brain Drain
results.original_title: LEGO DC Super Hero Girls: Brain Drain
results.overview: When Supergirl, Wonder Woman, Batgirl, Bumblebee and Katana suddenly realize they cannot remember a single moment from their Monday at Super Hero High, the young DC Super Heroes spring into sleuthing action! Suspecting foul-play, they band together to retrace their steps and uncover the mystery of who exactly stole their memories – and what nefarious plan might be afoot?

results.title: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract
results.original_title: Teen Titans: The Judas Contract
results.overview: Tara Markov is a girl who has power over earth and stone; she is also more than she seems. Is the newest Teen Titan an ally or a threat? And what are the mercenary Deathstroke's plans for the Titans?

results.title: Batman and Harley Quinn
results.original_title: Batman and Harley Quinn
results.overview: Batman and Nightwing are forced to team with the Joker's sometimes-girlfriend Harley Quinn to stop a global threat brought about by Poison Ivy and Jason Woodrue, the Floronic Man.

results.title: LEGO DC Batman: Family Matters
results.original_title: LEGO DC Batman: Family Matters
results.overview: Suspicion is on high after Batman, Batgirl, Robin and other DC superheroes receive mysterious invitations. However, family values must remain strong when Batman and his team encounter the villainous Red Hood, who is obsessed with destroying the Bat-family and all of Gotham City.

results.title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Gotham City Breakout
results.original_title: LEGO DC Comics Super Heroes: Justice League - Gotham City Breakout
results.overview: The caped crusader reluctantly agrees to let Batgirl and Nightwing take him on a long overdue vacation from crime-fighting, while Superman and the Justice League watch over Gotham City.

results.title: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights
results.original_title: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights
results.overview: As the home planet of the Green Lantern Corps faces a battle with an ancient enemy, Hal Jordan prepares new recruit Arisia for the coming conflict by relating stories of the first Green Lantern and several of Hal's comrades.

results.title: DC Super Hero Girls: Hero of the Year
results.original_title: DC Super Hero Girls: Hero of the Year
results.overview: Wonder Woman, Supergirl, Batgirl, Harley Quinn, Bumblebee, Poison Ivy and Katana band together to navigate the twists and turns of high school in DC Super Hero Girls: Hero of the Year.

results.title: Batman vs. Two-Face
results.original_title: Batman vs. Two-Face
results.overview: Former Gotham City District Attorney Harvey Dent, one side of his face scarred by acid, goes on a crime spree based on the number '2'. All of his actions are decided by the flip of a defaced, two-headed silver dollar.

results.title: DC Super Hero Girls: Legends of Atlantis
results.original_title: DC Super Hero Girls: Legends of Atlantis
results.overview: Siren steals the Book of Legends in order to locate the Trident of Atlantis and rule the entire ocean.
